preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 9 and 1 <= bi <= 9 and ai != bi for ai, bi in employees)
preconditions.description: Each employee's initial floor ai and destination floor bi are between 1 and 9 inclusive, and ai is not equal to bi.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimal possible time in seconds to deliver all employees to their destinations.
